section_summary.extract_value: This section details the Abbreviated Torrance Test for Adults (ATTA), a shortened version of the Torrance Test of Creative Thinking, used to assess divergent thinking. Participants completed three activities (one verbal, two figural) scored for fluency and originality. One participant did not complete the ATTA due to experimenter error.
